en: This postcard features an image of an ancient Greek vase painting. The scene depicts a seated woman playing a lyre, dressed in a yellow top and reddish-brown draped skirt, with hair tied back. There is an intricate Greek key (meander) pattern at the top, and some ancient Greek text inscribed near the figure. A small bird is drawn near the ground by her foot. The style is characteristic of Classical Greek pottery art.
